messages:
Ellen (People Ops): Quick drop 1 a tiny 'Hiring OKR + interviewer calibration micro-kit' for teams running loops. Copy/paste friendly.

Tom (Recruiting Manager): Nice. Can you add a one-line behavioral anchor per score? helps consistency.

Ellen (People Ops): Done. Kept it super short. Paste below.

hr-bot: Reminder: hiring-review sync tomorrow 10:30am - agenda at /hiring.

[KIT]
1) Hiring OKR example (one-line)
- Obj: Improve interview quality and throughput for infra hires.
- KRs: KR1: reduce time-to-offer from 28d -> 18d; KR2: raise hiring panel agreement to 85%; KR3: ship interviewer guide + 3 training sessions.

2) Interviewer self-review prompt (for loop owners)
- Paste 1 sentence: "Recommendation: [hire/no-hire]. Evidence: [concrete behavior]. Improvement: [one change for next loop]"

3) Tiny 3-point interviewer rubric (copyable)
- Green: Clear signal for hire; cites behaviors & outcomes. Anchor: asked follow-ups and validated problem-solving.
- Yellow: Ambiguous signal; mixed evidence. Anchor: good technique but missing impact examples.
- Red: Concern for role fit; missed key requirements. Anchor: vague answers or gaps on core skill.

4) Calibration pre-read (paste into doc)
- Candidate / Role / Interviewer provisional score (G/Y/R) / 1-line evidence / Main risk (1 short bullet)
Example: "Cand X / SWE II infra / Yellow / Solved system design but limited ops examples / Risk: scale experience"

Marc (People Ops Lead): Love this. Can you drop into the hiring playbook and link to the interviewer guide?

Ellen (People Ops): On it 1 will update the template and add character limits to self-review fields.

Priya (SWE): Will use this for our next panel. Short + practical.
